title: Turtles & Pirates
about: Adds the Turtle-folk race, who swim and can pop into their shell, a Pirate path for rogues, Bubble Shield, a Potion of Bounciness, and an anchor.

card.name: Pop into Shell
card.desc: Pop into your shell: +10 Armor, +10 on every save, and everything only does half damage to you. You can't move or attack until you pop out (bonus action).

card.name: Swashbuckle
card.desc: Swing on a rope up to 30 ft, then your next attack this turn gets {PROF} extra damage.
POP! A bubble gives you +5 Armor until your next turn.
Glug! For 1 minute you jump 3 times as far and take no falling damage.
